lines.beaver_en: Did your foreign language test score come out?
lines.learner: 네, 나왔어요. 제 점수는 칠십 점이에요.
lines.en: Yes, it did. My score is 70 points.
lines.roman: ne, nawasseoyo. je jeomsuneun chilsip jeomieyo.

lines.en: The listening questions were hard. They spoke fast.

lines.beaver_en: Listening was the hardest for me too.
lines.en: I wish my score were higher.

lines.beaver_en: It's okay. You'll do well next time.
lines.learner: 앞으로 문제를 더 많이 연습하고 싶어요.
lines.en: From now on, I want to practice more problems.
lines.roman: apeuro munjereul deo mani yeonseupago sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 교과서를 다시 봐요. 문제가 많아요.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's look at the textbook again. It has lots of problems.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom gyogwaseoreul dasi bwayo. munjega manayo.
lines.en: Good. Let's practice together with the textbook.

lines.beaver_en: Should we ask the teacher too?
lines.en: Yes, I hope the teacher will help us.

lines.beaver_en: Are you worried about the next test too?
lines.en: Sure. I hope the next test is easy.

lines.beaver_en: The next test is next Tuesday.
lines.en: Then let's practice an hour every day.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. Shall we meet at the library tomorrow?
lines.en: Yes, I'll bring my textbook and notebook.

lines.beaver_en: Then see you tomorrow at ten!
lines.learner: 네, 우리 둘 다 점수가 좋았으면 좋겠어요!
lines.en: Okay, I hope we both get good scores!
lines.roman: ne, uri dul da jeomsuga joasseumyeon jokesseoyo!
